tytul: Labneh balls in olive oil: why there is no recipe here
wstep: There is no recipe here for Middle Eastern labneh balls, salted strained yogurt kept in olive oil with za'atar, chili or mint.

ostrzezenia.tekst: Low-acid foods stored in oil create an oxygen-free environment that is perfect for the growth of Clostridium botulinum bacteria.
In Canada, the CFIA recalled a labneh in vegetable oil because it may permit the growth of Clostridium botulinum.
Food contaminated with Clostridium botulinum toxin may not look or smell spoiled but can still make you sick.

akapity: The Codex standard lists labneh as a traditional concentrated fermented milk, like strained yogurt.
JarAtlas has found no tested home recipe for labneh balls in oil from a checked source.
